feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Restaurateur and sister cleared of murdering their 100-year-old mother
articles.summary: A restaurateur and his sister have been cleared of murdering their 100-year-old mother with morphine.

articles.title: Capita shares at 35-year low as firm counts cost of civil service pension failures
articles.summary: Capita shares plunged more than 70% on Monday after the UK-based outsourcer revealed plans for a cash call amid an expected slump in profits linked to its troubled Civil Service pension scheme contract.

articles.title: Martin Property Group makes last-gasp pitch to seal Poundland rescue
articles.summary: The Northern Irish company which has been attempting to seal a solvent rescue of Poundland for more than six weeks has made a last-gasp plea to its owner to engage in talks on a deal which could save thousands of high street jobs.

articles.title: Snow forecast as cold health alerts in parts of UK
articles.summary: Wintry conditions are set for parts of the UK in the coming days, with snow, frost and sub-zero temperatures forecast.

articles.title: Hacker sentenced for leaking Grand Theft Auto VI clips
articles.summary: A man who hacked into the makers of Grand Theft Auto and leaked clips after stealing 90 gameplay videos from the sixth installment has been sentenced.

articles.title: Major trial to examine if AI can help detect breast cancer earlier
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of women taking part in the NHS breast cancer screening programme could have their scans assessed by AI to see if it leads to earlier diagnosis.

articles.title: Man charged with raping woman on Brighton beach
articles.summary: A 28-year-old man has been charged with raping a woman on Brighton beach in the summer.

articles.title: Suspect charged over death of man found injured in hospital car park
articles.summary: A suspect has been charged following the death of a young man who was found seriously injured in a hospital car park, almost 20 miles from where he was wounded.
